title: [Jolt] PhysicsServer3D.body_test_motion no collisions
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5.1.stable.arch_linux, v4.6.beta2.official [551ce8d47] - Not reproducible in: ### System information Arch Linux (up to date 04.jan.25) - Godot 4.5.1 (Forward+) - dedicated Radeon 9060 XT ### Issue description body_test_motion return almost always false when it should be true when certain conditions are met. - collider face must be in line with other colliders face. - motion must also be aligned - faces must not touch yet - PhysicsTestResult3D must be provided Green: test motion down Red: edge that triggers the bug Blue: object that should be detected but isn't ### Steps to reproduce the provided project should work out of the box. simply start test.tscn and there shout be a print output print: with result: false - without result: true "with result" means that an PhysicsTestResult3D was provided the other was without. expected would be for both to return true. when moving the character to any side or down it works as expected. moving the character up does not change the result. this issue is only in jolt. godot physics work as expected. the most confusing thing is that providing a PhysicsTestResult3D affects the collision detection. maybe an internal error returning null but not propagating an error message? ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [jolt-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24424142/jolt-bug.zip)
